title: Don't push that door
editor_notes: Wallpaper is a solo queue push. The story is the mistake, not the gunfight. End card holds from 29s.

shots.visual: One player breaks a door. The three squad markers stay outside.
shots.note: No name, no rank, no gun readable.

shots.visual: Teammate ping sits on the door. He crosses the threshold anyway.
Two icons on the ground ahead of him: a drop crate and the zone edge.
A third squad icon appears on the stairs behind him as he is still inside.
shots.note: Leave the footstep sting dry. Do not cover it with a shout.

shots.visual: Death cam, then a full-frame card.
